name: Hidamari no Kage de
source:
Main character attends school, but education is not what interests him. Instead he decides to train his childhood friend in SM manner, and seek other victims.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角上学，但他对教育不感兴趣。相反，他决定以SM方式训练他儿时的朋友，并寻找其他受害者。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
